description: Multiple on invested capital: total value returned (distributions plus current value) divided by the amount invested, with the implied annualized return when a holding period is given. Use tvpi_dpi for fund-level LP multiples. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/moic-calculator

invested_usd.description: Total capital invested, including follow-on checks.

value_returned_usd.description: Cash received from exits and distributions plus the current value of anything still held.

years.description: Holding period in years, used for the annualized return. 0 if unknown.

name: moic
